findings.affected_population_system: Displaced Palestinian families sheltering in tents; shelter, bedding, exposure and flood protection
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Eyewitnesses said heavy rain flooded thousands of displacement tents

bounded_discovery_context.discovered_in: Same 7 November Anadolu article, surfaced through direct publisher index during this hourly check
bounded_discovery_context.source_reporting_detail: Eyewitnesses described widespread rainwater flooding of displacement tents in named Gaza locations.
bounded_discovery_context.limitations: The 'thousands' count is eyewitness-reported, not independently quantified or verified by an aid agency; no confirmed deaths or specific displacement count.
